new_senses.rationale: Storm/sea narrative, wind and imminent capsizing support disturbance; only one attestation and finite/root analysis provisional.
Repeated human distress predicate and explicitly compared first-person plural Zʕiǧina support an inflecting integrated predicate; Detransitive allocation remains provisional.

added_examples.turoyo: Huwwe bu baḥər, qayəm hawa w ʕalʕole, ʕalʕole, ʕalʕole... w zaʕəǧ w kqaymi. I qammiyaṯṯe gədqulbo w gədməḥnoqi bu baḥər.
added_examples.translation: He was on the sea; then wind and storms arose, storms, storms... and they raged and arose. Their ship was going to overturn and they were going to drown in the sea.
added_examples.rationale: Only storm attestation for provisional new I.1; wind and threatened ship retained as context.

added_examples.turoyo: "Ya raaaaaabb!" omər, zʕiǧ, zʕiǧ xəd uʕdo d kəmmət: "Zʕiǧina".
added_examples.translation: "O Lord!" he says; he was alarmed, alarmed, just as now you say: "We are alarmed."
added_examples.rationale: Only independent human-distress context; includes repeated zʕiǧ and metalinguistic Zʕiǧina, quoted once for three records.
